findings.reason: the arm as written can never pass on its own cited evidence, so the section needs a source in which reckon-project shared-root file claims are actually evaluated, or a different definition of both the numerator and the floor.
findings.text: the zero-with-floor clause cannot be satisfied by the three copies §4 names: across all three the only claimed file path is `scripts/iter/integrated_simulation.py`, held 401, 396 and 699 times by the stale run `r-20261108T065757180968-unverified-switching-windows-s2` ("records no worker process yet"), and that path belongs to power_convertor, which ships no `shared-write-paths.json` at all — read by path prefix this is 699 held-on-claim verdicts on a shared-root file path rather than zero, and read against the run's own project declaration it is zero evaluations of a file claim under a shared root, below the 20 the clause now demands, so the arm reports either a failure or "unmeasured" no matter how §2 behaves

findings.reason: without naming a join to the run ledger (`docs/state/reckon/runs/`) as the denominator's source, the measuring node has no way to compute the floor and will report a pass or a failure it cannot evidence.
